targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM gold.dim_customer WHERE dbt_valid_to IS NULL

SELECT round(100.0 * count(distinct fpo.customer_key) FILTER (WHERE fpo.status NOT IN ('delivered','closed','cancelled')) / nullif(count(distinct dc.customer_key),0), 1) AS pct_open FROM gold.dim_customer dc LEFT JOIN gold.fact_purchase_orders fpo ON fpo.customer_key = dc.customer_key WHERE dc.dbt_valid_to IS NULL
SELECT truck_status, count(*) AS trucks FROM silver.truck_current_position GROUP BY truck_status
SELECT date_trunc('$time_grain', d.date) AS time, count(*) AS orders_created FROM gold.fact_purchase_orders f JOIN gold.dim_datetime d ON d.date_key = f.order_date_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('$time_grain', s.delivery_time) AS time, count(*) AS orders_delivered FROM gold.fact_shipments s WHERE s.is_delivered GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT status, count(*) AS orders FROM gold.fact_purchase_orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY orders DESC

SELECT fs.customer_segment, sum(fs.line_amount) AS revenue FROM gold.fact_sales fs JOIN gold.dim_datetime d ON d.date_key = fs.order_date_key WHERE date_trunc('$time_grain', d.date) = date_trunc('$time_grain', now()) GROUP BY fs.customer_segment ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT fs.zone_city, sum(fs.line_amount) AS revenue FROM gold.fact_sales fs JOIN gold.dim_datetime d ON d.date_key = fs.order_date_key WHERE date_trunc('$time_grain', d.date) = date_trunc('$time_grain', now()) GROUP BY fs.zone_city ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT fs.category, sum(fs.line_amount) AS revenue FROM gold.fact_sales fs JOIN gold.dim_datetime d ON d.date_key = fs.order_date_key WHERE date_trunc('$time_grain', d.date) = date_trunc('$time_grain', now()) GROUP BY fs.category ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT status, count(*) AS invoices, sum(amount) AS total_amount FROM gold.fact_invoices GROUP BY status
SELECT payment_reminder, count(*) AS invoices, sum(amount) AS amount FROM gold.fact_invoices WHERE status = 'settled' GROUP BY payment_reminder ORDER BY payment_reminder

SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'settled' THEN 'settled' WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelled' WHEN due_payment_date IS NULL THEN 'no due date' WHEN now() <= due_payment_date THEN 'not yet due' WHEN now() - due_payment_date <= interval '30 days' THEN '1-30 days overdue' WHEN now() - due_payment_date <= interval '60 days' THEN '31-60 days overdue' WHEN now() - due_payment_date <= interval '90 days' THEN '61-90 days overdue' ELSE '90+ days overdue' END AS aging_bucket, count(*) AS invoice_count, sum(amount) AS amount FROM gold.fact_invoices GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.purchase_order_id, f.truck_id, dz.city AS zone_city, po.target_delivery_date, now() - po.target_delivery_date AS overdue_by FROM gold.fact_purchase_orders f JOIN silver.purchase_orders_current po ON po.purchase_order_id = f.purchase_order_id LEFT JOIN gold.dim_delivery_zone dz ON dz.zone_id = f.zone_id WHERE f.status = 'in-transit' AND po.target_delivery_date < now() ORDER BY overdue_by DESC

SELECT date_trunc('$time_grain', d.date) AS time, avg(fdp.delay_days) AS avg_delay_days, avg(CASE WHEN fdp.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100 AS pct_on_time FROM gold.fact_delivery_performance fdp JOIN gold.dim_datetime d ON d.date_key = fdp.target_delivery_date_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('$time_grain', d.date) AS time, avg(fdp.process_time_seconds)/3600.0 AS avg_process_hours FROM gold.fact_delivery_performance fdp JOIN gold.dim_datetime d ON d.date_key = fdp.order_date_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
